name: Cordon destroyer, the Hegemony Navy's ion escort (Hegemony Navy)
shape_ref_yaw_note: null until measured: stage 3 measures the long axis (common.shape_ref_yaw, ai_align); read the overlay, then write the value here (plus 180 if the bow came out aft)
notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/hegemony_H8/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/hegemony_H8.py; issue 1412). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 9.5, the Destroyer class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. Concept: Muse run 3 Cordon (issue 1146, PR 1707), taken by Ryan Nov 22 2026. game_code H8_23 is the Destroyer folder the game picks for hegemony (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old hull there, copied aside first. bake stack: stage 5 paints it with the Hegemony kit's paint stack (tools/blender/kits/hegemony/stack.py, through tools/blender/r209/bake_sheet.py).
